biggest_catch: You only get the $100 if your friend becomes a DFCU member and closes an auto loan of $15,000 or more within six months — existing DFCU auto loan refinances are ineligible. A friend who joins but never borrows earns you nothing.
catches: Auto loan tier: friend must become a member and close an auto loan of $15,000 or more within six months of registration.
Offer not valid on existing DFCU auto loan refinances.
Not available to referred persons who are already DFCU members.
All deposit and loan accounts must meet membership, identity verification, and credit criteria.
Reward Card arrives 4-6 weeks after qualifications are completed.
DFCU may amend, suspend, or terminate the referral program at any time without notice.
Tax treatment not stated; treat as potentially reportable income.

c1.evidence: DFCU Financial's official ReferLive referral page on dfcufinancial.com/Open-An-Account/Referlive, fetched live 2026-09-23.

c2.evidence: Page states: "You will earn $100 when your referral becomes a member and opens a qualifying checking account or auto loan" and the Auto Loan section confirms the existing member receives a $100 Reward card per qualifying auto loan referral.

c3.evidence: Friend (new member, not existing) must register via ReferLive and close a $15,000+ auto loan within six months; existing DFCU auto loan refinances ineligible.

c4.evidence: No fee charged to the referrer; registration via the free ReferLive Auto Loan Program.

eligibility: DFCU Financial existing members; referred friends must be new members (not existing DFCU members), U.S. residents, and complete ReferLive registration.
notes: VERIFIED: DFCU Financial referral program (auto loan tier) on dfcufinancial.com, checked live 2026-09-23. This is the route-granularity split of former combined R4316 (now checking-only): referrer earns a $100 Mastercard Reward card per qualifying auto loan referral; members can earn up to $1,000 total across the program. The checking tier is R4316; the mortgage tier ($275/referrer) is R4317. Deduped: no existing DFCU auto-loan referral route.
numeric_basis: payout from official DFCU terms ($100 Reward card per qualifying auto loan referral); time: registering + sharing a referral link est. 5-15 min active.

payout_value_note: $100 Mastercard Reward card per qualifying auto loan referral; $1,000 overall program cap — numeric fields hold per-referral payout.

steps: Register for the DFCU ReferLive Auto Loan Program.
Share the referral offer with friends and family.
Friend becomes a DFCU member and completes ReferLive registration.
Friend closes a new auto loan of $15,000 or more within six months (refinances of existing DFCU auto loans ineligible).
You receive a $100 Reward card per qualifying referral.
timing: Reward Card arrives 4-6 weeks after the referred person completes all qualification requirements.
